row: Dr. B. Likely | The RA Warrior Chiropractor

Hi, I am Dr. Randi B. Likely (most patients call me Dr. B.) and I initially started my channel to share my journey with Rheumatoid Arthritis as a D1 athlete. I am now a Chiropractor with my own practice in Houston, TX. As a wife and new mom, I love to share what life looks like balancing my many hats.
